equireplicate balanced incomplete block designs possess many properties that make them useful for agricultural and horticultural research.

the models, test statistics and estimators of treatment effects for equireplicated variance-balanced block design are generalizations of those for balanced incomplete block design, that these models are appropriate to the designs and that the test statistics have distributions that are known.
